subject: Request: Pilot extension + credits & promotional discount — Novaterra
messages:
From: Ethan Cole <ethan.cole@novaterra.com>
To: Maya Srinivasan <maya_srinivasan@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Priya Shen <priya.shen@novaterra.com>
Date: Tue, 3 Feb 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Novaterra POC — ask for extension + combined promo/credits

Hi Maya,

Quick note from procurement — our legal review is running into scheduling delays and the team is asking for a 60-day extension on the POC timeline. Given the expanded scope we also want to re-open the commercial ask: would Redwood consider a combined package of additional free credits and a promotional discount on year-one list pricing?

High-level context: we increased expected token usage ~2.5x after adding multimodal ingestion to the POC. Procurement is sensitive to cost given our Q2 budget gates. If you can provide a modest promo + top-up credits that should get us across the finish line and signed PO.

What we need to make a decision:
- 60 day pilot extension
- $20k–$30k in usage credits applied to the POC period
- a promotional 10–15% list discount for the first 12 months tied to the initial commit (if we convert)

I attached our updated RFP/usage forecast for reference. Can you let me know what flexibility exists and who on your side I should expect to see for exec sign-off?

Thanks,
Ethan
Ethan Cole
VP, Product & ML Systems
Novaterra
attachments: Novaterra_RFP_v1.xlsx (xls)

From: Maya Srinivasan <maya_srinivasan@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 3 Feb 2026 10:07:00 -08:00
Subject: Fwd: Novaterra POC — ask for extension + combined promo/credits

Team — forwarding Novaterra's ask. TL;DR: they need a 60-day pilot extension and are requesting a combined credit top-up plus a promotional discount tied to an initial commit. They bumped expected token volume ~2.5x which materially affects economics for the POC.

Proposed internal options for exec consideration (feel free to edit):
- Option A (conservative): 30-day extension, $12k credits, 8% promo discount on year-one list pricing.
- Option B (balanced): 60-day extension, $22k credits, 12% promo discount if they sign a 9–12 month commit within 30 days of PO.
- Option C (growth push): 60-day extension, $30k credits, 15% promo discount + a 6-month usage guarantee.

Questions for leadership: what is the maximum credit allowance we can grant without a CRO/Finance sign-off? Does Legal need to prepare a short SOW addendum? I can propose the final terms to Ethan once we have internal alignment.

I attached their RFP forecast — see page 3 for the token ramp.

Cheers,
Maya
Director, Solutions Engineering
Redwood Inference
attachments: Novaterra_RFP_Response_v2.pdf (pdf)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Maya Srinivasan <maya_srinivasan@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 3 Feb 2026 11:20:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Novaterra POC — ask for extension + combined promo/credits

Maya — thanks for the summary. A couple quick clarifying points before we escalate to Jonas:
- Do we have an updated safety/SLA profile for the larger token footprint? If there are any additional infra costs (bursting to dedicated capacity), need to quantify.
- Is Novaterra willing to sign a revenue commit or a minimum spend to offset credits? That helps a lot with approval thresholds.

From a commercial perspective I can approve up to $15k in credits + 10% promo discount at my level if they agree to a 6–9 month commit and PO within 21 days. Anything above that needs Jonas/CRO approval. If Legal can do an addendum template, we can speed the DocuSign.

Marissa
Head of Sales Operations
Redwood Inference

On Tue, Feb 3, 2026 at 10:07 AM Maya Srinivasan <maya_srinivasan@redwoodinference.com> wrote:
> Team — forwarding Novaterra's ask...

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Maya Srinivasan <maya_srinivasan@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 5 Feb 2026 08:45:00 -08:00
Subject: Escalation: Novaterra promo + credits request — financials attached

Looping in Jonas for approval beyond the $15k credit threshold. I ran the updated price model against their revised forecast and attached the Pricing_Calculator_2026.xlsx (sheet: Novaterra_Ramp). Summary:
- Incremental gross margin hit through credits is ~6% on year-one ARR at the mid-point ask ($22k credits + 12% discount).
- If we grant Option B (60d + $22k + 12%), probability of conversion based on similar deals is ~55% within 90 days — reasonable upside.
- Risk mitigation: require PO within 14 days of approval and include a one-way usage cap during POC so costs are contained.

Recommended ask to Jonas: approval for Option B with the following conditions:
1) PO within 14 days
2) SOW addendum limiting the POC usage to the forecasted ramp with quarterly reconciliations
3) Discount capped to year-one only and contingent on commit signature

If Jonas greenlights, Legal — please prep the SOW addendum and DocuSign envelope.

Ben
Enterprise Sales Director
Redwood Inference
attachments: Pricing_Calculator_2026.xlsx (xls)

From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>, Maya Srinivasan <maya_srinivasan@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 6 Feb 2026 14:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Escalation: Novaterra promo + credits request — financials attached

Thanks for the analysis, Ben. Approve Option B with one change: cap credits at $22k (of the $30k ask) and set promo discount to 12% (year-one only). Conditions:
- Novaterra must issue a PO within 14 calendar days of our approval.
- Legal to prepare an SOW addendum outlining the extension, credit redemption mechanics, and a one-way usage cap tied to their forecast.
- Finance to code credits as a sales concession against the deal for Q1 reporting.

Maya — please confirm to the customer and copy Legal with the approved terms. I want the DocuSign envelope sent to Ethan and Priya within 48 hours.

Jonas
Chief Revenue Officer
Redwood Inference

On Thu, Feb 5, 2026 at 08:45 AM Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com> wrote:
> Looping in Jonas for approval beyond the $15k credit threshold...

From: Maya Srinivasan <maya_srinivasan@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ethan Cole <ethan.cole@novaterra.com>, Priya Shen <priya.shen@novaterra.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>, Legal Team <legal@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 6 Feb 2026 15:10:00 -08:00
Subject: Approved: Novaterra pilot extension + credits & promo (next steps)

Ethan / Priya — thanks for your patience. Good news: leadership has approved a combined concession to help bridge your procurement timeline. Approved terms (summary):
- Pilot extension: 60 days from current PO end date
- Credits: $22,000 in usage credits applied to the POC period
- Promo: 12% off list for year-one, contingent on signed commit within 30 days of PO
- Conditions: PO issued within 14 days of this approval; SOW addendum will include a one-way usage cap tied to your forecast and quarterly reconciliation clauses

Legal will send a short SOW addendum via DocuSign in the next 48 hours. Please review and return the signed envelope so we can put the addendum in place and extend the pilot. If you need any tweaks on the usage cap numbers, let us know and we can coordinate a quick reconciliation call.

Looking forward to getting you across the finish line.

Best,
Maya Srinivasan
Director, Solutions Engineering
Redwood Inference
attachments: SOW_Addendum_template.docx (docx)
